issues.title: Backlinks and Outgoing links always list the open note's links, also after returning to a note seen at the same index version
issues.trigger: Reading or browsing without saving: open note A, then note B (stay over 150 ms), then go back to A (tab click, wikilink, back), and expand Backlinks or Outgoing links. No save or watcher event in between, so vaultIndexVersion does not move (it only moves on a vault-index-updated refresh, 2 to 10 s after a save).
issues.what_to_build:
Both link panels have a per-path skip cache in front of one store that holds no path. A cache hit then means 'this path was fetched at this version once', not 'the store holds this path's data now'.
- Backlinks: `fetchBacklinksV2Inner` (src/lib/features/backlinks/backlinks.service.ts:141-150) returns early when `lastFetchedBacklinksVersion.get(path)` (Map at :19, set at :164) equals the current version. The store `linkedMentions` (backlinks.store.svelte.ts:4) is overwritten by every other path's fetch (:163), and the +layout.svelte tab-switch effect (src/routes/(app)/+layout.svelte:105-141, call at :129) fetches every note you visit, panel open or not. After A -> B -> A the store keeps B's mentions, and the expand click (BacklinksPanel.svelte:24-30) is skipped the same way. When the panel was expanded at the switch, BacklinksPanel.svelte:32-38 resets the store and the same skip leaves it empty ('No backlinks found', :68-69).
- Outgoing links: `fetchOutgoingLinksV2Inner` (src/lib/features/outgoing-links/outgoing-links.service.ts:65-70) skips on a per-path key `${version}:${content.length}:${path}` (Map at :16, set at :85). OutgoingLinksPanel.svelte:30-36 calls `outgoingLinksStore.reset()` on a path change while expanded but leaves the key map alone (only `resetOutgoingLinks`, :96-99, clears it). Re-expanding A then skips and renders 'No outgoing links' (:64-65). If the panel was collapsed by hand on A and B was fetched before at that version, B shows A's links.
Fix direction: make the skip apply only when the store currently holds that path's result at that version (for example one 'last written' key per store instead of a per-path Map, cleared whenever the store is reset or written for another path). Keep the burst-save elision for repeated calls on the same path. Relationship backlinks have no cache and are correct today; leave them alone.

issues.trigger: Read-only navigation with no index change in between: open note A, open note B (or follow a wikilink from A), go back to A, then expand Backlinks. issues.trigger: Text mode with the fuzzy toggle on (the default), a misspelled word of 3+ characters such as `meating`, in a vault large enough to hold more than 500 distinct indexed words (content, titles, paths, headings, tags) that start with the same letter and sort before the intended word.

LIKE also gives fts5vocab no term bound, so each fuzzy term walks every earlier letter. Fix direction: bound the candidate scan by term range (term >= first letter AND term < next code point) and by a length window from auto_distance, and drop or move the cap so it cannot cut candidates by alphabet.
